runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 09:56 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, StartupJobs, WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. Strongest new verified candidate is IKEA Bratislava contact centre / after-sales service (job ID 355434): active on IKEA Bratislava location listing, full-time, partial home office after onboarding, no experience required, English only an advantage, customer support/reklamacie scope. It is promotion-ready but was not persisted into jobs-data.json in this run because the available writer only supports complete-file replacement and the safe canonical feed could not be transformed transactionally without reconstructing all 56 records. Existing AGEL Lab admin-tech support remains active on canonical AGEL careers. IKEA job 354106 still has live localized detail pages but is absent from the current Bratislava location job list, so it is treated as stale/ambiguous and not promoted. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical vacancy-list membership gate
developmentChanges.reason: An individual ATS detail can remain publicly reachable after a vacancy drops from the employer's current location/job listing. Promotion now requires either current list membership or another explicit active/Apply signal; this prevents stale localized detail pages from being treated as fresh vacancies.

developmentChanges.title: Same-employer sibling role pivot
developmentChanges.reason: When a promising role is stale, inactive or ambiguous, immediately scan the same employer's currently listed sibling roles in the same functional family. This surfaced IKEA job 355434, a stronger current customer-support fit, instead of repeatedly rechecking stale job 354106.
